## Activity

During March 2025, East City Eye Clinic recorded 222 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and should be used as the reference point for review of the site’s operational performance. The activity was documented by the clinic team and is reported here without adjustment. Follow-up records should retain the site and month details so that subsequent checks can be matched to this report.

## Image quality

Image quality records show 2 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 0.9 per cent. These figures should be considered together when reviewing the quality of images submitted from East City Eye Clinic. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support consistent recording and follow-up.

## Grading

During the month, 60 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This summary records the grading outcome and the time measure for March 2025. The figures should be retained with the activity and image quality information to support routine monitoring of the clinic’s service.
